data.one_liner: An MVVM architecture library for Flutter that separates UI, logic, and data layers.
data.what_it_does: Elementary provides widgets, view models, and models that work together to keep the UI declarative while allowing business logic to be testable and independent. It uses an observer pattern to rebuild only the parts of the UI that depend on changing state.
use_when: You want clear separation of concerns between UI and logic
You need efficient rebuilds with minimal boilerplate
You prefer a declarative UI approach with testable business logic
avoid_when: You are already using another state‑management solution like Riverpod or Bloc
You need advanced dependency injection or navigation features not covered by Elementary
weaknesses: Limited to MVVM; no built‑in navigation or DI
Requires learning its specific widget and model classes
